protocol.name: wayray_wm_v1
protocol.description:
This protocol allows an external window manager process to control window layout, focus, and keybindings in the WayRay compositor.
Only one WM client may be bound at a time. If a second WM binds, the first receives a "replaced" event and should disconnect.
Window management follows a two-phase transaction model: 1. Manage phase: WM makes policy decisions (dimensions, focus, decorations) 2. Render phase: WM specifies visual placement (position, z-order, visibility)

interface.name: wayray_wm_manager_v1
interface.description: The main entry point for external window managers. A WM client binds this global to receive window lifecycle events and participate in the two-phase manage/render transaction model.

event.name: window_new
event.description: Sent when a new toplevel is mapped. The WM receives a wayray_wm_window_v1 object to interact with this window. Property events (title, app_id, size_hints) follow immediately, terminated by a done event.

event.name: window_closed
event.description: Sent when a toplevel is unmapped and destroyed. The wayray_wm_window_v1 object becomes inert after this event.

event.name: manage_start
event.description: Sent when state changes require WM policy decisions. The WM should evaluate pending changes and respond with policy requests on the affected window objects, then call manage_done.

event.name: render_start
event.description: Sent after clients have acknowledged configures and committed. The WM should set visual placement (position, z-order, visibility) on window objects, then call render_done. All changes are applied atomically.

event.name: output_new
event.description: Sent when a new output is available for window placement.

event.name: output_removed
event.description: Sent when an output is no longer available.

event.name: replaced
event.description: Sent when another WM client has connected and taken over. The old WM should disconnect gracefully after receiving this event.

request.name: manage_done
request.description: Signals that the WM has finished making policy decisions for this manage phase. The compositor will send configures to affected windows.

request.name: render_done
request.description: Signals that the WM has finished specifying visual placement. The compositor will apply all changes atomically in one frame.

request.name: get_seat
request.description: Creates a wayray_wm_seat_v1 object for registering keybindings and initiating interactive move/resize operations.

request.name: get_workspace_manager
request.description: Creates a wayray_wm_workspace_v1 object for managing virtual desktops and window-to-workspace assignments.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy this manager object. The compositor returns to its built-in window management.

interface.name: wayray_wm_window_v1
interface.description:
Represents a single toplevel window. The compositor sends property events and the WM sends policy/placement requests.
Policy requests (propose_dimensions, set_focus, etc.) should be sent during the manage phase. Visual placement requests (set_position, set_z_*, etc.) should be sent during the render phase.

event.name: parent
event.description: Null if this window has no parent.

event.name: fullscreen_request
event.description: Respond with grant_fullscreen or deny_fullscreen during manage phase.

event.name: dimensions
event.description: Actual committed size after client draws.

event.name: done
event.description: Process all preceding property events atomically.

description.summary: give keyboard focus to this window
set window position relative to output origin
place at top of z-order stack
place at bottom of z-order stack

interface.name: wayray_wm_seat_v1

description.summary: keybinding and input management for WM

interface.description: Register keybindings, create binding modes, and initiate interactive move/resize operations.

request.name: bind_key
request.description: Empty mode string means default mode.

description.summary: create a named binding mode (like i3)

request.name: activate_mode
request.description: Empty string returns to default mode only.

description.summary: destroy seat interface and all keybindings

interface.name: wayray_wm_workspace_v1
interface.description: Create and manage virtual desktops. Supports both exclusive workspaces and tag-based systems (windows on multiple tags simultaneously).

description.summary: set visible workspace on an output

request.name: set_window_tags
request.description: Window is visible when any tag matches the output's active tags.
